items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: I think Dick Gibson started this years ago in Colorado

ctx.x: These jazz parties are an interesting little phenomenon in the country and I hope they continue.

I do too. It’s a nice concept. I think Dick Gibson started this years ago in Colorado, and a lot of other jazz societies around the country decided that they would take a weekend and call it either a jazz festival or a jazz party. And incidentally, this one here at the Jerome is just superb. It starts with a party and ends with a party.
